label: Role Status
description: Where a Role occupancy currently sits in its own lifecycle, shared by every person-role and organization-role subtype via the role concept's inherited `status` property.

values.label: Planned
values.definition: The role occupancy has been agreed but has not yet started.

values.label: Active
values.definition: The role occupancy is currently in effect.

values.label: Suspended
values.definition: The role occupancy is temporarily paused without having formally ended.

values.label: Ended
values.definition: The role occupancy concluded as expected, e.g. at its effectiveTo date.

values.label: Cancelled
values.definition: The role occupancy was called off before or without reaching its expected conclusion.
